          0 < ε →
            scaleCover δ (_root_.cylinder E) W →
              ∃ J,
                (∀ (i : ℕ),

                      height '' W i ⊆ J i ∧
                        volume (J i ∩ unitI) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Metric.diam (W i) + padding ε s W i)) ∧
                  ∀ t ∈ unitI, content s δ E ≤ ∑' (i : ℕ), (J i).indicator (fun t0 => Metric.ediam (W i) ^ s) t) →
    (∀ (c : ℝ≥0∞) (w : ℕ → ℝ≥0∞) (J : ℕ → Set ℝ),
        (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasurableSet (J i)) →
          (∀ t ∈ unitI, c ≤ ∑' (i : ℕ), (J i).indicator (fun t0 => w i) t) →
            (∀ (i : ℕ), Measurable ((J i ∩ unitI).indicator fun t0 => w i)) ∧

                c ≤ ∑' (i : ℕ), w i * volume (J i ∩ unitI)) →
      (LipschitzWith 1 base ∧

            ∀ (δ : ℝ) (W : ℕ → Set (V (n + 1))),

                            Metric.ediam (height '' W i) ≤ Metric.ediam (W i)) →
